hypotheses.text: If Lukas Hagen (CB, home) had been 5 m closer to Kai Nakamura, the shot would likely have been blocked/forced off-target and the chance of a goal would have dropped, explaining how defensive positioning changed the outcome.
If Kofi Asante-Rhys (LB, home) had been 5 m closer to Kai Nakamura, increased pressure from the left could have reduced shooting space and accuracy, lowering the likelihood of a goal.

If Kai Nakamura had passed to Theo Varga (CM) instead, a different final action (shorter-range shot or combination) might have produced a higher expected goal probability than the low-probability long shot that became the goal.
